description: Move on, move out of the way. The key is to pivot. #selflove #pivot #moveon
transcript: I can, unlike a person, place or thing very quickly, do not stay and wait around for things to prove themselves. I allow things to be just as they are. I don't want to change anything. I don't want to change anyone. I want the world to move and flow as it should, and in turn, I move accordingly. I will remove myself from any situation. It does not matter how long I've been in it. I will always move into spaces that nourish and develop me. As soon as something begins to make me feel hesitant or reserved or restricted, I move out of that equation.
